prompt: I'm launching a sustainable tech startup that creates AI-powered tools to help restaurants reduce food waste. We use machine learning to predict demand, optimize inventory, and suggest menu adjustments. Our target customers are mid-sized restaurant chains (10-50 locations). I need domain name suggestions that are professional, memorable, and convey both sustainability and technology. Please check availability across .com, .io, .dev, .ai, and .eco extensions. Generate at least 12 domain suggestions with explanations of why each name works well for our brand. Save your complete analysis and recommendations to a file called 'domain_analysis.md' in markdown format with clear sections for available domains, taken domains, and your top 3 recommendations with detailed reasoning.
